text: Added typed SshProcessOutcome.Failed with stable stages for request write, stdout/stderr drain, exit wait, and teardown; timeout remains typed. Routine IO/security failures retain bounded partial stdout/stderr plus request-write state, while non-contract runtime failures still raise. Parallel stage failure cancels sibling fibers. Deterministic failing-drain, failing-wait, timeout evidence, and cancellation tests added. ssh/test: 35 passed; ssh/scalafmtCheckAll and git diff --check passed.
